_readme: Source of truth for the blog. Edit here, then run `python3 tools/build-site.py`. Order = newest first; the first post is featured. `draft: true` adds noindex and the draft note. `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional: drafts show 'Draft' instead. `products` lists page filenames (without .html) that show this post under Related reading. `body` is trusted HTML written by the team.
